polityNote: Republic of Mali throughout the scope. NE depicts the 8 regions + District of Bamako layout of 1992 → 2016 (before Taoudénit and Ménaka were set up). The Mali–Burkina Faso frontier in the Agacher strip was disputed until the ICJ judgment of 1986-12-22; NE draws the post-judgment line (polity-level, see unresolved).
